question: Mando is a form of a folk song from the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mando.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mando **is a musical form that evolved among the **Goan Catholics of Goa, India during the 19th and 20th centuries**.
 
• The meeting point of local Goan and Western musical traditions is portrayed.
 
• Dekhṇi is a semi-classical dance form of Goa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
